text:
Ravi: dropping an informal runbook for staging the adaptive-lattice sampler on the 13B quant candidate. aim: ~12% token savings, keep user-visible regressions <0.4% on our multi-bucket evals. skim and flag obvious misses.
Becca: good scope. can we be explicit about what "adaptive-lattice" does in ops terms? like: two-pass decode where second pass expands uncertain tokens, with early-exit heuristics.
Ravi: yep that's the model. practical constraints: we must never increase p95 latency for the latency-tier customers. so plan is to attach sampler profile to non-latency routes only, and provide a greedy fallback for latency routes.
Jun: proposed eval buckets:
- tiny queries (<=64 tokens)
- medium answers (64-512 tokens)
- longform (512+ tokens)
- RAG / citations (ctx-heavy)
We should sample 5k prompts per bucket from anonymized prod traces.
Sam: checklist idea:
- local smoke: deterministic run on 600 examples (seeded)
- artifacts: per-request decision trace + token probs + chosen path id
- canary: 2% traffic, 72h, stratified by bucket
- full AB: 14d if canary looks clean
Becca: rollback triggers suggestion: any bucket with >=0.5% absolute drop in accept_rate OR >20% increase in user-facing error rates OR p95 latency > baseline*1.2.
Ravi: accept_rate definition: automated heuristics + small human review sample. Jun will wire the auto checks.
Jun: will do. also we should compute semantic drift using embedding cosine to reference outputs. thresholding: mean cosine drop >0.03 flagged.
Sam: infra notes: keep traces sampled at 1/200 by default. store minimal fields: request_id, model_version, sampler_profile, decisions, token_count, p50/p95 latency. use compression (zstd) and TTL 30 days.
Becca: hyperparams to sweep (narrow):
- lattice_expand_prob: [0.05, 0.1, 0.2]
- uncertainty_cutoff: [0.08, 0.12]
- early_exit_min_tokens: [16, 32]
Record each run with experiment_id and git sha.
Ravi: minimal local command:
```bash
export MODEL=/mnt/models/13b-quant-candidate
python -m experiments.run_sampler \
  --model $MODEL \
  --sampler adaptive_lattice \
  --cohort 600 \
  --seed 101 \
  --out out/local-adaptive-run.ndjson
```
Jun: example output (dev):
```
accept_rate: 0.995
cost_tokens: 0.87x
latency_p50: 48ms -> 50ms (+4%)
latency_p95: 210ms -> 255ms (+21%)
note: tail amplification for large-concurrent loads
```
Becca: tail amplification again. mitigation proposals: limit lattice depth during high-concurrency, or dynamic admission (if queue_depth > X, use greedy). add this to rollout gates.
Sam: agree. I'll add queue-aware fallback in the runtime shim. quick patch: if pending_requests > 12 -> sampler=greedy.
Ravi: owners: Ravi -> run smoke and paste results today; Sam -> implement queue-aware fallback and schedule canary; Jun -> build accept_rate auto-checks + embedding drift; Becca -> run human review sampling plan and thresholds.
ops-bot: canary scheduled: 2026-05-10T09:00Z for model: 13b-quant-candidate + sampler: adaptive_lattice (notify: #eng-ml).
Ravi: action items recap and deadlines:
1) Ravi: local smoke + paste ndjson trace (due today)
2) Sam: runtime fallback + canary orchestration (due 48h)
3) Jun: auto-eval metrics + embedding baseline (due EOW)
4) Becca: human QA plan + review sheet (due EOW)
Please keep replies short; report only blockers. :eyes:
